description: Site header with logo, primary navigation menu, and hamburger toggle on mobile. Reads a registered WP nav menu by theme location. Template-owned chrome (issue 223): it is rendered once by the theme, never composed. Its colors are set through whitelisted site options (update_site_option), NOT by composing a nav or passing props directly. The style props below document the template contract; base.php maps the pp_header_* site options onto them.

location.description: WP theme location slug for the nav menu.

logo_text.description: Logo text wordmark. Falls back to pp_site_title() when empty. Shown when no logo image resolves.

logo_id.description: Media Library attachment ID for the logo image (NOT a URL). Must be an image attachment; a non-image or non-existent ID is rejected when the action is validated (same rule as the pp_logo_id site option). When set to a valid image it renders an img tag instead of the text wordmark. Resolution order: this prop, then the pp_logo_id site option, then the WP custom_logo theme-mod.

logo_alt.description: Alt text for the logo image. Defaults to the attachment's own alt metadata, then logo_text/site title.

bg.description: Header background (issue 333). Set via the pp_header_bg site option; emitted as the --header-bg custom property. Accepts a CSS color (hex, rgb()/hsl(), transparent, currentColor, or a known color-token reference) OR a bounded linear-gradient()/radial-gradient() with 2+ color stops — the shared `gradient` slot type. Empty = the default page background. This is the primary dark/gradient marketing-header control.

text.description: Header text color (issue 333). Set via the pp_header_text site option; emitted as --header-text. Applies to the logo wordmark and the mobile hamburger toggle. A CSS color (no gradient). Empty = the default text color.

link_color.description: Header nav-link color (issue 333). Set via the pp_header_link_color site option; emitted as --header-link-color. A CSS color (no gradient). Empty = the default text color. Hover and current-page links keep --color-accent, which is a global design token.
